goal: Bring the Trò chuyện tab and AI Council start screen to the ChatHub and Council designs: a hub with Tiếp tục, a Nilaza Oracle card, the Council row, guide chips and a three-column guide grid; Oracle becomes an on-device direction chooser that never pretends to be AI; the Council start screen shows topic chips, three guides, the headline, three starter questions and the composer, with custom guide selection moved into the menu. The Council server requires sign-in and allows one council per local day (not deployed). Short guide names are drafted for Owner review.
successCriteria: The chat hub shows Trò chuyện with a search button, Tiếp tục with the latest conversation and its last message, the Nilaza Oracle card with Bắt đầu kể, the Hội đồng 3 góc nhìn row, Người dẫn chips (Tất cả, Tình cảm, Chữa lành, Triết gia), a three-column grid of eight guides plus Xem cả 17, and the transparency note.
Oracle replies come from the on-device direction chooser with action cards and a label that says it is a suggestion, not an AI answer; no Oracle server call is made.

Council opens on topic chips mapped to the four templates, three guides with their roles, the headline, three starter questions and the composer; Tự chọn người dẫn, history and report live in the menu; the Cosmic Symposium panel is removed.
ai-council requires a signed-in account before any model call and allows one council (with up to four follow-ups) per local day from the shared tier policy; the change is not deployed in this task.
docs/content-review holds a draft of 17 short guide names and taglines; the app keeps current names until approval.
Mobile check, Jest suite, Deno policy tests and validate:backend pass; a 390x844 web walkthrough covers hub, Oracle and Council.
untouchedSurfaces: No deploy, SQL, secrets or Supabase settings; ai-council deploy is a separate Owner approval.
Persona names and content data stay unchanged until the drafted short names are approved.
Tarot, Astrology, Journal and Profile screens.
